title: 335 lbs (150 kg) SSB close stance box squats for 12
summary: This set of deadlift stance box squats didn't feel good. The SSB somehow manages to be both really comfortable and a total torture device. If you want a lift that will challenge both your will power and cardio, this is it. I knew I needed to psych myself up and get to work; ended up doing my 3 other sets and hitting 12 reps each time.
